description: This file defines the 'Model' class within the Opencart System Engine namespace. It provides a base class for models, managing access to the Registry object through magic methods __get, __set, and __isset, enabling dynamic property handling.

classes.name: Model
classes.description: Base class for all models in the Opencart system, providing registry management and dynamic property access.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Model with a Registry instance.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Allows dynamic access to registry properties, throwing an exception if the key does not exist.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Allows dynamic setting of registry properties.

methods.name: __isset
methods.description: Checks if a registry key exists.
